english: Boy, is the master of the household here? He is not here; he went to the assembly. Dear guest, welcome! Shall I sit at your hearth? Sit, and I will give you mead and meat. You are young and wise. Who told you this? The old men say this: a guest is dear to the gods. What is your name, guest? I am Of-Goodly-Fame; I come from a far village.
